main_text.p: Hæsere biga, territus ungulas Sudore se vano fatigans Rupit equum, trepidosque currus? Vouete diris moenia tristibus Urbis Meroza, ceu Patris Angelus Ales supremi mandat. Ecce Supplicio graviore jamjam Cum gente tota funditus erui Sunt digna. Sanctas namque Deo tribus Fidis recusarunt juvare Auxiliis per acuta bella. Caelestis at te gratia sospitet Coniunx Heberi: te modo foeminas Inter celebres clariorem Fama Iahel potior reponat. Namque insequentes quum fugeret pauens Sisera dextras, aedibus & tuis Latere celatus rogaret, Atque sitim relevare vili Unda: trementem mox recipis domum, Et pinguioris cymbia regibus Præbenda tradens lactis, hostem Arte ferum laqueas sagaci. Nam, dum quiescit, seque periculis Procul remotum mortiferis putas Irrumpis audax, & iacentem Non solita ratione perdis. Confossa clauo tempora (malleum Vibrante

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The verse is set in italic type; the whole stanza is italic and is not marked with <i> tags here, so check the italics if needed. "Vouete" and "Præbenda" are copied as printed and are not certain. "iamiam" was read as "jamjam". The catchword "Vibrante" continues the line that the page ends on, which is the printed catchword. Faint show-through from the reverse side at the top right is omitted.
